Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class PidDrawingRecordsDexpiWriter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.PidDrawingRecordsDexpiWriter
public final class PidDrawingRecordsDexpiWriter extends Object
Writes a Proteus-profile DEXPI P&ID from drawing records extracted from a P&ID sheet.

The input is a neqsim_pid_drawing_records.v1 JSON document: equipment and off-page connector nodes with nozzles (ports), pipe-junction (tee) nodes, traced pipe runs (edges) with their drawn centre lines, inline valves and instrument bubbles. Such records are produced by a drawing extractor (for example a vector-PDF reader) or by hand, and are a draft that must be reviewed against the controlled drawing.

The written file keeps the drawing geometry (converted from PDF points with y down to millimetres with y up), so DexpiXmlSvgRenderer regenerates a P&ID that follows the source sheet, and it is accepted by DexpiXmlReader and DexpiSimulationBuilder. Nozzles carry the PortRole attribute so multi-outlet equipment is wired to the right outlet. Pipe runs that carry no flow in normal operation (drains, flare, chemicals, sampling) are written with NormalFlow=false and are left out of the steady-state flowsheet.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

    • appendInlineItem

      private static void appendInlineItem(Document document, Element parent, com.google.gson.JsonObject inline, String itemId, PidDrawingRecordsDexpiWriter.Sheet sheet)
      Appends an inline piping item (valve, flange, reducer or blind) with two nozzles and its symbol.

      Valves and blinds carry NormalPosition (Open or Closed) and, when read from the drawing, LockingStatus (LO, LC, CSO, CSC). A normally closed valve is drawn filled.

      Parameters:
      document - target document
      parent - piping network segment
      inline - inline item record
      itemId - DEXPI id of the item
      sheet - coordinate conversion
